{{Quote|We drew lots to see who would try to blow open a hole in the ship's hull. This man's name I remember. D'kar. The rest of us escaped.|General Airen Cracken|<ref name="CRFG" />}}
'''D'kar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] resistance fighter who worked with [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]]. Once, a group under Cracken's command, including D'kar, were captured by [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] men and held in the hold of a stock [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]]. Scrounging in the hold netted them a [[positive flow detonator]] and a member of the group, [[Briggs (Cracken)|Briggs]] accessed the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] system and obtained a [[negative power coupler]]. They intended to create a bomb by fusing the two together and blast a hole in the side of the ship. Lots were drawn to see who would try to detonate the jury-rigged explosive, and D'kar was chosen. The plan worked, but D'kar was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the explosion with the rest escaped.
